summary: Fortress Private Lending Fund filed an 8-K reporting the unregistered sale of 182,155 Class I common shares at $24.13 per share (NAV) for $4.4M aggregate consideration, along with a June 2026 distribution of $0.1812 per share and quarterly portfolio commentary. The sale was made under Section 4(a)(2) and Regulation D to accredited investors. This is a routine capital raise and distribution announcement, not a special situation. There are no special-situation elements such as a tender offer, going-private, or other transformative event.
